p:
Last week was our roughest yet: real-money DCA return slid from −5.79% to −13.23%, Friday alone −3.87%.

The DCA Score leaned in: every order was boosted, up to +60% on NFLX. One order day slipped. Still 0.56% ahead of traditional DCA.
pz:

DCA Score 選擇加碼：每一筆下單都有加碼，NFLX 最多加碼 +60%。有一天漏單。整體仍領先傳統 DCA 0.56%。
